visualCharacteristics.purpose: floating Línea Madrid chat launcher fixed in the lower-right corner of the viewport
visualCharacteristics.summary: Blue speech bubble with a white border and white uppercase text (LINEA MADRID / CHAT ONLINE / ASISTENTE VIRTUAL), with a small orange close cross above its top-right edge.

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: a link to where the chat runs; optional bubble image
contentPattern.notes: Fixed-position overlay: it takes no space in the page flow. Without a link it is informational only.

usage: Once per page, in its own section at the end of the page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any floating launcher (chat, help). The real madrid.es chat only runs on www.madrid.es (its gateway accepts that origin only), so the link opens madrid.es.
